conceptZh: 科學家老鼠想用夾子夾起筆畫，夾子自己有意見一直夾錯，最後老鼠用燒杯蓋住它，叔叔玩偶從冒泡泡的燒杯裡出現。
object: a bespectacled cartoon lab mouse in a tiny white coat, a stubborn pair of giant tweezers, and a bubbling beaker with a bearded toy figure inside
morph: a prop-fights-back pair of tweezers keeps lifting the wrong pieces until the mouse outsmarts it and the strokes drop into the glyph 叔
creativeAngle: 道具反抗：夾子自己有想法，一直夾錯筆畫，老鼠最後用磁鐵騙過它；「叔叔」用鬍子玩偶從燒杯泡泡裡冒出來呼應。
promptEn: An 8-second lively cartoon lab clip on a clean solid pale aqua backdrop. The only text in the frame is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 叔, drawn with thick glossy saturated emerald-green strokes, about 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped. Lead: a bespectacled cartoon lab mouse in a tiny white coat among bubbling beakers; one supporting prop, a giant pair of tweezers with its own opinions. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Voice: warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin saying exactly 叔、叔、叔叔 (ㄕㄨ、ㄕㄨ、ㄕㄨ ㄕㄨ˙); the second syllable of the word takes the neutral tone; slow clear tones, then silence. Moment 1 (0–1.7s): the mouse pushes his glasses up and, as the first 叔 is spoken, reaches for a green stroke piece with the tweezers, but the tweezers snap shut on his own tail-tip ribbon and spin him around once. Moment 2 (1.7–3.4s): the tweezers go rogue, stretching and wagging like a snake, flinging the long left strokes into the air, catching a beaker and juggling it, the mouse chasing with a butterfly net, ears flat. Moment 3 (3.4–5s): the mouse outsmarts it by dangling a tiny horseshoe magnet; the tweezers lunge for the magnet and slam the pieces into place just as the second 叔 is spoken, forming 叔: a left side with a tall vertical, a cross bar, and a small diagonal pair, and a right side hand shape with a slanted stroke and a long falling sweep. Moment 4 (5s): the word 叔叔 is spoken as the beaker beside the mouse overflows with rainbow bubbles and a small friendly bearded toy figure in a collared shirt rises out of it on a bubble, tipping a hat. Final 5–8s: the glyph 叔 stays absolutely still and sharp while the mouse and the bearded toy figure shake hands on the side, both bouncing a bit, bubbles drifting gently, never covering the strokes. Soft daylight, no flashing, no real people, no other writing.

meaning: uncle (father's younger brother; friendly form of address for a grown man)
conceptZh: 布忍者躲在一片小葉子後面以為沒人看見，跳出來拿泡棉劍和玩具消防隊長的水管來一場友誼對決；兩人都大揮空、原地打轉，「咚」地撞頭坐下，煙霧彈還在這時爆開，掉落的劍、水管噴頭、頭盔和煙霧彈排成「叔」字，最後留鬍子的消防隊長就是那位揮手的「叔叔」。
object: a tiny charcoal felt ninja with a yellow belt and a foam sword, dueling a chunky mustached toy fire captain whose hose has a mind of its own
morph: after the head BOINK and a mistimed smoke-bomb puff, the dropped foam sword, hose nozzle, helmet and smoke pellets land as the royal-blue strokes of 叔: the left column 尗 (上 on top, 小 below) and the right-hand 又
creativeAngle: 改走友誼對決的大動作喜劇，告別前版安靜的釣魚與夾子鬧劇。笑點全是看得見的實體：布忍者「隱身」失敗、兩人大揮空轉圈、撞頭坐下、煙霧彈在最糟的時機爆開，筆畫由撞掉的道具落地排成。詞語「叔叔」由對手本人示範：留鬍子的消防隊長站起來捲鬍子、大揮手，說話與畫面同一個故事。讀音採教育部標準 ㄕㄨˊ，詞語 叔叔 讀 ㄕㄨˊ ㄕㄨ˙。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright cartoon slapstick clip on a clean, solid pale cream backdrop with soft daylight and nothing busy behind. The only text ever on screen is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 叔, built from thick glossy saturated royal-blue strokes, filling about 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped with margins. Cast: the lead is a tiny charcoal felt ninja with button eyes, a yellow felt belt and a floppy foam sword, who is spectacularly bad at hiding and fully convinced he is invisible. One rival: a chunky mustached toy fire captain in a red helmet standing beside his boxy toy fire engine, holding a hose that has a mind of its own. No real people, no background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no flashing.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin speaks exactly 叔、叔、叔叔 (ㄕㄨˊ、ㄕㄨˊ、ㄕㄨˊ ㄕㄨ˙), reading precisely those syllables slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between each utterance, the second syllable of the word light and unstressed, then silence. Nothing else is spoken.

Moment 1, want it (0–1.5s): the felt ninja crouches in plain sight at frame left behind a single tiny leaf, giggling silently, sure nobody can see him, while the fire captain at frame right squats in a sumo-ready pose holding the shiny hose nozzle. The ninja points dramatically at the nozzle: he wants to win this duel. As the first 叔 is spoken he leaps out of "hiding" and winds his foam sword back in a giant wind-up that bends his whole felt body like a bow.

Moment 2, try and miss (1.5–3.3s): the ninja swings so hard he misses completely and spins three times like a top, sword wobbling. The captain counterattacks, swinging the hose like a club in an equally huge wind-up, but the hose twists on its own and squirts a cartoon water puff straight into his own face, knocking his red helmet up into the air and spinning him around. Both stagger dizzy toward the center of the frame, eyes going in circles.

Moment 3, the big crash (3.3–5s): a frozen half-beat of anticipation, both wobbling nose to nose, then BOINK, their heads bump with cartoon squash-and-stretch and they plop down on their bottoms with dazed grins. At the worst possible instant the ninja's smoke bomb pops with a soft round puff of pale gray smoke. Out of the puff the dropped things rain down and land as 叔, snapping into place exactly as the second 叔 is spoken: on the left, the foam sword stands as the tall vertical with the fallen helmet strap forming the short horizontal near its top and the hose laid flat as the longer horizontal beneath, forming 上; below it the hose nozzle hangs as the small central hook with two smoke pellets as the dots on either side, forming 小; on the right the limp hose coils into 又, a horizontal that folds down into a sweeping diagonal, crossed by a long falling stroke. All strokes are the same solid royal blue, crisp and correctly proportioned.

Moment 4, payoff (5–8s): the glyph 叔 stays perfectly still, sharp and centered for the final three seconds. At about 5.3s the word 叔叔 is spoken exactly as the mustached fire captain stands up at frame right, twirls his mustache, and gives a big friendly wave: he is the 叔叔 the voice names. The ninja pops up at frame left and they shake hands, both bouncing a little from the dizziness. In the last second the ninja ducks behind his tiny leaf again, obviously still visible, and peeks out with a proud thumbs-up, while a single harmless drip falls from the hose end. Nothing ever covers or touches the strokes. Bright but not neon, no white blowouts, no dark grading, no other writing anywhere.
